title: Lateen deployed smoke report
description: What the post-deployment smoke gate saw on the public site: every route at desktop and mobile width in light and dark, the HTTP status of its document, and the first failure when a visit failed. The base and commit name the deployment, so the report records which commit is live. Cases are in execution order and carry no wall-clock time.

base.description: The public URL the deploy published, with its base path and a trailing slash.

commit.description: The commit that was deployed. It identifies the run instead of a timestamp.

ok.description: True only when every visit passed.

status.description: The document response's HTTP status; 0 when the route returned none.

error.description: The first failure on this visit.
